close_reason: Added Dispatcher::try_register returning Result<(), DuplicateMethodError>. register kept with expanded doc pointing at try_register. DuplicateMethodError is pub, #[non_exhaustive], Display+Error. Tests pin both paths. Workspace clippy passes — no downstream migration forced.
description:
crate-jmap-server/src/lib.rs:168-174 — Dispatcher::register uses HashMap::insert and silently replaces any existing handler under the same method name. The doc admits this. In the workspace pattern where each extension crate ships a register_*_handlers macro that registers ~10 method names against a Dispatcher, a typo or accidental double-registration (e.g. mail register_mail_handlers + a second register call) silently drops one binding with no diagnostic.

The maintenance consequence: a future contributor adding a method that collides with an existing one will see their handler never fire, with no compile-time or runtime error pointing at the cause. They will spend time debugging "why doesnt my handler get called" and the dispatcher will not help.

Recommendation: change the signature to fn register(...) -> Option<Arc<dyn JmapHandler<CallerCtx>>> returning the previous handler (matching HashMap::insert), or add a fn try_register(...) -> Result<(), DuplicateMethodError> that errors on collision. Either makes the silent-overwrite an explicit choice at the call site.

Backwards-compat: changing the return type from () to Option<Arc<...>> is a breaking change. Could land an additive try_register first, deprecate register, and remove in the next major.
title: Dispatcher::register silently overwrites on duplicate method name
